April 21, 2026 - The Florida Agency for Health Care Administration (Agency) is issuing this Request for Applications (RFA) to establish grant agreements with eligible subrecipients under Florida\u2019s Rural Health Transformation Program (RHTP). RHTP is a five-year, federally funded initiative administered by the Agency under the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Cooperative Agreement No. 1RHTSSCMS332067-01-00 (the \u201ccooperative agreement\u201d). The RHTP was developed pursuant to Florida\u2019s approved RHTP application and the Medicaid and Children\u2019s Health Insurance Program (CHIP) funding authorities under Title XIX and Title XXI of the Social Security Act.

The RHTP is organized around five strategic goals \u2014 Make Rural America Healthy Again, Sustainable Access, Workforce Development, Innovative Care, and Tech Innovation \u2014 and is implemented through 14 distinct initiatives described in the RFA.
